decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions ofClass A, Part 2, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, the existing front gate and fence to the north and south of the proposed access shall be permanently retained in their present design and not replaced with any solid fencing.  No hedge or obstruction shall be installed within 1 metre either side of the proposed crossover to a depth of 1 metre within the garden from the back line of the footway.
description: Formation of vehicle crossover and creation of hard standing area.
